title: NHTCU meets ONI/DOJ; extradition threat of 70 years
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of NHTCU meets ONI/DOJ; extradition threat of 70 years, about 2002 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: November and then they threatened extradition then on paper it was 70 years in jail.

plain: A British computer hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he found signs of a secret space programme while breaking into US government computers, tells of what followed in 2002. He says the UK's National Hi-Tech Crime Unit, a British police cybercrime team, met with the Office of Naval Intelligence and the US Department of Justice. He says they then threatened to send him to the US for trial, where on paper he faced 70 years in jail.
